cues: Keep the temperature fixed, and squeeze the gas to double its pressure.
By Boyle's law its volume halves, so its density doubles too.
P over rho does not change, and neither does the speed.
text: First, pressure. Keep the temperature fixed, and squeeze the gas to double its pressure. By Boyle's law its volume halves, so its density doubles too. P over rho does not change, and neither does the speed.
